# (APPENDIX) Appendices {-}

# BPMN symbols {#symbols}

Every BPMN 2.0.2 symbol that tok draws, with the statement that produces it and whether Camunda 8 executes it. The pictures are made by the tok engine itself: each one comes from a small model exported with `tok bpmn` and `tok svg` and cut to the element (`tools/symbols.py` of the tok repository), so a symbol here looks exactly as it does in your diagrams.

In the column *tok*, words in capitals (`ID`, `ACTIVITY`, `P`) stand for identifiers of your model, and the values (`"M"`, `P1D`) are examples. *Not executed* means that Camunda 8 does not run the element; in an executable document `tok check` reports the code given ([Chapter 10](#executable)). *Modelling only* elements are exported and kept, and the engine ignores them. Groups (`group ID "Label" members="A B"`) are exported as BPMN groups without a shape in the diagram, so they have no symbol here.

```{r symbol-tables, results='asis'}
family <- NULL
for (s in symbol_catalogue()) {
  if (!identical(s$family, family)) {
    family <- s$family
    cat("\n\n## ", family, " {-}\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("| Symbol | Element | BPMN | tok | Camunda 8 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n")
  }
  cat(sprintf("| %s | %s | %s | `%s` | %s |\n", symbol(s$id, "2.6em"), s$en, s$bpmn, s$tok, s$camunda))
}
```
